extracted.name: Fiesta potato 😍
extracted.description: REMEMBERING our so favorite food item of TACO BELL it's so simple to make at home. #madethis #mymexican
instruction_lines: First prepare cheese sauce.lets roast the flour in 1 tbsp butter and cook for 2 minutes then add milk and spices together.cook for 2 minutes and add shredded cheese.just mix well no need to cook now
Now deep fry the potato dices at high flame to make fast golden and spread over cheese sauce then spread chopped green onions
Enjoy so much mouthwatering taco Bell's recipe FIEASTA POTATO at home.stay safe stay healthy and happy with me
